conflicts: Shares outstanding / market cap: Equibles shows ~3.35B shares ($9.34M mkt cap @ $4.65, tagged to a 2026-05-07 'last earnings' date) vs Morningstar and Google Finance both showing ~2.01M shares ($8.52M mkt cap @ $4.16) vs TipRanks/AlphaQuery showing ~588K shares ($12.06M mkt cap, data appears to date from around Oct 2025). The spread (588K to 3.35B) is too large to be mere staleness and strongly suggests one or more reverse stock splits plus ADS-ratio confusion across data vendors. Not resolved this session — flagging per runbook guidance rather than guessing a ratio.

Cash runway: a secondary/third-party analysis implies <8 months of runway on $10.8M combined cash+investments at a ~$1.3M/month burn rate, while the company's own Aug 2026 financing disclosure (424B3) states net proceeds — assuming FULL warrant exercise — are expected to fund operations into H2 2029. These are not necessarily contradictory (the gap is the warrant-exercise assumption), but both readings are recorded since they could mislead if conflated.
